slide1.headline: Tesla Acquires AI Hardware Company
slide1.subtitle: A significant move in the AI hardware space

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Tesla acquired an AI hardware company for $2 billion.
This acquisition is expected to enhance Tesla's AI capabilities.
The deal was announced on 24 Jul 2026.
The AI hardware company's technology will be integrated into Tesla's products.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This acquisition highlights the growing importance of AI in the tech industry.
Tesla's move is expected to boost its competitiveness in the market.
The deal may also lead to advancements in AI hardware technology.
Other companies may follow suit with similar acquisitions.

bullets: The acquisition price of $2 billion indicates the high value of AI hardware technology.
